svg.title: Compact overview of the Hist14 MobilePixorNeXt detector
svg.desc: LiDAR to Hist14 BEV encoding, MobilePixorNeXt with Focal Context and SG-FPN (collapsed into the detector box), grouped heatmap, metric offset, log-size, doubled-angle and IoU-quality heads. The right arrow denotes BEV detection after decoding and NMS. Five downward arrows denote OGA training supervision. Any 3D cuboids require subsequent LiDAR-based vertical lifting outside this panel.

g.font-family: Times New Roman, Liberation Serif, DejaVu Serif, serif
